what: The room itself as a sound source. It turns the weather outside, the venue's own instrument and the rings of the looper into signals you can patch like any other: each gives a level and a gate, a signal that is on (1) or off (0), like a button being pressed.
how: Each source here has two jacks. The first is its level, a number between 0 and 1 that is smoothed so it moves gently: patch it into a CUTOFF, a VCA's cv or any other control input to let the room move your sound. The second, ending in _g, is its gate: it goes high for about 0.05 seconds each time something happens (a raindrop, a drip, a struck note, a looper note beginning). Use a gate to start an ENV or a drum. These are worked out from the song's clock, so everyone in the room hears the same. A source with nothing behind it (no weather, no instrument, no layer) stays at zero.

outs.weather: Level of the weather on the window (rain, snow or storm): how heavy it is right now in the song, 0 to 1. It follows the song's bars and moves slowly. Silent in a cave, which has drips instead.
outs.drips: Level for the cave's drips: each drip makes it jump to a value set by how hard the drip fell, then back to zero after a moment. Only in the cave.
outs.venue: Level for the venue's own instrument: each time it is struck the level jumps to how hard the strike was, then falls back to zero. Only in a venue that has one.
outs.ring1: Level of the lowest ring of the looper: how loud the note playing in that layer is, 0 to 1, and 0 between notes.
outs.ring2: Level of the looper's second ring, the same way: how loud its current note is, 0 between notes.
outs.ring3: Level of the looper's third ring: how loud its current note is, 0 between notes.
outs.ring4: Level of the looper's fourth ring: how loud its current note is, 0 between notes.
outs.ring5: Level of the looper's fifth ring: how loud its current note is, 0 between notes.
outs.ring6: Level of the looper's sixth ring: how loud its current note is, 0 between notes.
outs.ring7: Level of the looper's seventh ring: how loud its current note is, 0 between notes.
outs.ring8: Level of the looper's eighth ring: how loud its current note is, 0 between notes.
outs.marbles: Reserved for the marble run, which has been taken out of the room: this stays at zero for now.
outs.weather_g: Gate: goes high for a moment on each drop that hits the window, so every raindrop can trigger an ENV or a drum.
outs.drips_g: Gate: a short pulse for each drip in the cave.
outs.venue_g: Gate: a short pulse each time the venue's instrument is struck.
outs.ring1_g: Gate: a short pulse each time a note begins in the looper's lowest ring.
outs.ring2_g: Gate: a short pulse each time a note begins in the looper's second ring.
outs.ring3_g: Gate: a short pulse each time a note begins in the looper's third ring.
outs.ring4_g: Gate: a short pulse each time a note begins in the looper's fourth ring.
outs.ring5_g: Gate: a short pulse each time a note begins in the looper's fifth ring.
outs.ring6_g: Gate: a short pulse each time a note begins in the looper's sixth ring.
outs.ring7_g: Gate: a short pulse each time a note begins in the looper's seventh ring.
outs.ring8_g: Gate: a short pulse each time a note begins in the looper's eighth ring.
outs.marbles_g: Reserved for the marble run, which has been taken out of the room: it never fires for now.

try: Patch WORLD's weather_g into ENV's gate, ENV's out into a VCA's cv, with a VCO into the VCA and the VCA into OUT. With the weather on, each raindrop plays a short note. Or patch WORLD's weather into a filter's cutoff so the sound opens and closes with the weather.
